description: The "XYZ123 - Copy" table contains patient admission information, including demographics, admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, insurance details, language, religion, marital status, ethnicity, emergency department visit timestamps, diagnoses, and flags indicating expiration and chart data availability. Each row represents a unique hospital admission identified by the `HADMID` primary key. The data spans from 2100 to 2210.

columns.name: SJID
columns.description: Subject ID: Identifier for the subject or patient. A single subject can have multiple hospital admissions.

columns.name: HADMID
columns.description: Hospital Admission ID: Unique identifier for the specific hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMTM
columns.description: Admission Time: Date and time when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DCTM
columns.description: Discharge Time: Date and time when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DTHTM
columns.description: Death Time: Date and time when the patient died.

columns.name: ADM_TP
columns.description: Admission Type: Type of admission, e.g., ELECTIVE, NEWBORN, URGENT.

columns.name: ADM_LOC
columns.description: Admission Location: Location or source of the patient prior to admission.

columns.name: DSC_LOC
columns.description: Discharge Location: Location to which the patient was discharged.

columns.name: INSR
columns.description: Insurance: Type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANG
columns.description: Language: The primary language spoken by the patient.

columns.name: MAR_STS
columns.description: Marital Status: The patient's current marital status.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Emergency Department Registration Time: Date and time when the patient registered in the emergency department.

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Emergency Department Out Time: Date and time when the patient left the emergency department.

columns.name: DIAG
columns.description: Diagnosis: Primary diagnosis recorded for the patient during this hospital admission.

columns.name: EXP_FLG
columns.description: Expiration Flag: Indicates whether the patient expired during the admission (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHRT_DATA
columns.description: Has Chart Data: Indicates whether the patient has chart data available (1) or not (0).
